Resolves #21325
Related: #21140

Hoists a single persistent group navigation index (`Portal.view.examples.GroupIndex`) and mobile crumb/sheet into `Portal.view.examples.MainContainer` beside a card-managed `.portal-examples-stage`, applies the 21-group `"The list"` re-cut (unbanded `Apps` above 5 bands, `Trees` / `Task Board` / `Tabs` renames, `timeline` retired into `grid-table` + `alsoIn: ['scheduler']`, `alsoIn: ['tree']` on both tree grids, `helix` renamed `3D Helix`, `EXAMPLE_FAMILY_SEO` / `Portal.service.Seo` / `seo.json` aligned), turns `/examples` (`Overview.mjs`) into `"Start here"` with the 12 catalog-ordered `featured: true` demonstrations (`Workstation` as the `2×2` lead card, `Data Grid: 100k Rows & 200 Columns` second, and `Country Statistics Grid` replacing `3D Helix` as the 12th card), switches wide desktop grids to 3 columns with active `<a class="portal-example-open-cue">` `"Open live ↗"` launch links + `"live examples"` + `"Multi-window"` cues (`#21131`), and removes `GroupList` plus `ExampleGroup` `image` / `tile` with regenerated `docs/output/class-hierarchy.json`.

Declared change class: `capability` (`feat`). `agent-preflight: not hosted here`; local staged husky checks ran on commit (`check-theme-coverage`, `check-shorthand`, `check-derived-domain`, `check-whitespace`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-theme-value-files`, `neo-agent-skills-secrets`, `neo-agent-skills-ticket-archaeology`, `check-block-alignment`, `check-content-root-derivations`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, `check-parse`).

Evidence: L5 (Whitebox E2E with Neural Link across 2 themes × 7 desktop/phone viewports + PNG pixel-contrast measurement + pointer/touch/keyboard `"Open live ↗"` activation across builds & multi-window targets + refreshed Workstation-led `c83f1a7691` dark/light renders + 2 blind swapped cold-reader Look evaluations) -> L5 required (AC-1..AC-6).

## Cold look

Two blind `flash` readers (`research` subagents `81cbbf8b` and `42686c74`) evaluated the final Workstation-led 16-frame set (`c83f1a7691`) in swapped unlabelled pairs as first-time front-end engineer visitors:

- **Reader 1 (`81cbbf8b`, `Option A` = `before`, `Option B` = `after`):**
  - Entry: **`5 / 10` (`before`) -> `8 / 10` (`after`)** · Grid & Table: **`6 / 10` (`before`) -> `8.5 / 10` (`after`)**
  - Why: Persistent left rail eliminates navigation shift and replaces internal category names with engineer-oriented sections; asymmetric `Workstation` (`Multi-window`) + stacked `Data Grid` / `TreeGrid` bento lead + 6 visible cards in `Grid & Table` + explicit `Open live ↗` cues make direct live launching unambiguous; mobile Entry keeps `[All 17 groups ▾]` and live preview cards above the bottom fold.
  - First action on `before`: Desktop `▶ Open the 100,000 × 200 grid` hero CTA; Mobile `▶ Open the 100,000 × 200 grid` (no visual cards above the fold).
  - First action on `after`: Desktop click **`Open live ↗` on the `Workstation` bento lead card**; Mobile tap **`Workstation` (`Open live ↗`) card** visible immediately beneath `Start here` (or `▶ Open the 100,000 × 200 grid`).
- **Reader 2 (`42686c74`, `Option A` = `after`, `Option B` = `before`):**
  - Entry: **`5 / 10` (`before`) -> `8 / 10` (`after`)** · Grid & Table: **`6 / 10` (`before`) -> `8 / 10` (`after`)**
  - Why: Persistent desktop rail (`All 17 groups`), Workstation-led bento hierarchy (`Workstation` 2×2 + `Data Grid` + `TreeGrid`), white chevron fix on dark mobile `Grid & Table`, explicit `Open live ↗` launch cues, and crisp desktop/mobile contrast (also eliminating the washed-out white `Forms & Fields` card on `before` Entry and mobile `or the Workstation →` edge collision).
  - First action on `before`: Desktop `▶ Open the 100,000 × 200 grid` (or `Grid & Table` link); Mobile `▶ Open the 100,000 × 200 grid`.
  - First action on `after`: Desktop click `▶ Open the 100,000 × 200 grid` or **`Workstation` bento card's `Open live ↗`** (with `Grid & Table` in the persistent left rail); Mobile tap `▶ Open the 100,000 × 200 grid` or the **`Workstation` card** right below `Start here`.
- **Remaining ambient items flagged by both readers (follow-ups outside Shell):** `Multi-window` top-right pill overlaps preview toolbar chrome; light-theme card covers (`Table Filtering`, `Country Statistics Grid`) belong to `#21140` Stream 4 dark-mode captures; compact 1×1 subtitles truncate near card bottoms; `390px` site header bar hides theme/social icons and crowds subheader alignment.
